items.title: Zcash’s landmark NU7 upgrade goes live, speeding up private payments
items.summary: NU7 cuts the target time between blocks to 25 seconds, reduces the work wallets must do to find private payments and sets aside fees for future miners.

items.title: Zcash NU7 upgrade goes live, leaves 12,224 ZEC stranded in Sprout pool
items.summary: Zcash’s NU7 upgrade has rendered about $15 million in legacy Sprout funds unspendable, although a future network upgrade could potentially restore access.

items.title: Ethereum devs won’t fork Glamsterdam on Hoodi until smart contract risks resolved
items.summary: Ethereum developers are investigating concerns tied to eight smart contract invariants tied to Glamsterdam’s EIP-8037 and EIP-8038.

items.title: Binance cuts SignalPlus access after security warning, urges users to check accounts
items.summary: The exchange says its systems are unaffected but has removed trading connections to the third-party platform as a precaution.

items.title: Ukraine’s central bank opposes crypto bill, citing monetary sovereignty concerns
items.summary: Ukraine’s central bank won’t back a crypto legalization bill in its current form and wants lawmakers to revise it before a final vote.

items.title: Bitcoin holders have received eCash — What can you do with it?
items.summary: Bitcoin’s eCash fork gives eligible holders an equivalent balance of ECX, but questions remain over where they can trade the tokens and what they can do with them.

items.title: US sanctions Canadian money-exchange firms over Iran ties
items.summary: US  also offers as much as $20 million and possible relocation for information about Iran’s nuclear program.

items.title: Suspicious prediction market activity seen before election poll release: NYT
items.summary: Bets were placed shortly before two recent New York Times/Siena political polls were released to the public, according to a report.

items.title: Nvidia may face a more hostile post-election Washington: Report
items.summary: CEO Jensen Huang’s relationship with President Donald Trump probably won’t save the company from a more adversarial Washington, Semafor says.

items.title: After Binance, check what your signing systems can approve

items.title: Apple, Meta reject OKX–ICE tokenized stock plans, leaving crypto firms as the ones to watch
items.summary: Strategy, Coinbase, Circle and Robinhood are among six companies from the venture’s initial selection with no disclosed objection, after 90% of issuers opted out.

items.title: U.S. prediction markets regulator issues demand that clashes directly with courts
items.summary: The Commodity Futures Trading Commission said regulated exchanges can't cut off customers state-by-state, but firms like Kalshi are under court orders to do so.

items.title: The crypto industry has found new ways to grow. Making money from them is another story
items.summary: Coinbase, Robinhood and Circle are expanding into stablecoins, payments and prediction markets, but their latest earnings show how hard it is to escape crypto's boom-and-bust cycles.

items.title: Thailand moves to block Bitget as crypto exchange's local acquisition faces uncertainty
items.summary: Thailand’s SEC filed a criminal complaint against Bitget’s operator, alleging it ran an unlicensed crypto exchange for Thai users from 2022 to 2025.

items.title: U.S. added 165,000 jobs in October, blowing past 65,000 estimate
items.summary: The unemployment rate unexpectedly fell to 4.1%. The strong showing surely puts a December rate hike in play, but next week's inflation numbers and the fate of the stock market could prove more important.

items.title: Live updates: Bitcoin flatlines under $76,000 as stock bounce loses steam into the close
items.summary: The Nasdaq gained just 1.1%, while the S&P 500 only edged higher, and the DJIA lost more ground.

items.title: Bitcoin steadies after AI-led selloff as eyes turn to latest U.S. jobs figures
items.summary: Bitcoin bounced from around $75,200 after Thursday’s AI-led selloff, which drove more than $1 billion in liquidations, as traders await the U.S. jobs report.

items.title: Bitcoin recovers $76,000 level as ETFs shed $430 million after tech rout
items.summary: Bitcoin recovered above $76,000 Friday after dropping below that level during Thursday's tech-driven market rout.

items.title: Greece approves 10% tax on crypto gains and 15% levy on DeFi income
items.summary: Investors will have 12 months to declare past crypto gains without late-filing penalties, though questions remain over crypto-to-crypto swaps.
